fee_notes: Transaction Fees: 0.80%-3.0% of sales price depending on performance level (levels 1-6 tiered by cumulative transactions/sales). Associate Royalty Fee: 2% of sales price (Associate franchises only). Monthly Fee: $399/month (includes UGVille software, Microsoft Office 365 base, 4 email addresses). Technology: up to $425/month. Local Marketing: Level 1 none required, Level 2-3 minimum $1,000/month, Level 4-6 minimum $5,000/month. Marketing Fund Contributions: $300 per transaction (max $1,000). National Advertising Fund: variable contribution. Transfer Fee: $7,500 (Associate) or $17,500 (Full). Renewal Fee: $2,000. Multiple other fees disclosed including training, convention, office visits, audits.
raw_excerpt: Monthly Fee: $399 per month, payable first day of each month. Local or Regional Marketing: Level 4, 5 and 6 franchisees must spend at least $5,000 per month for local advertising; Level 3 and 2 franchisees must spend at least $1,000 per month. Transaction Fee Schedule: Level 1 (3.0%), Level 2 (2.0%), Level 3 (1.5%), Level 4 (1.25%), Level 5 (1.0%), Level 6 (0.80%) of Sales Price.
